architecture.tabModel: One global workspace tab strip. Every browser page, file, PDF, spreadsheet, Terminal, Files, Git, Usage, and Notes surface is a peer tab; there is no nested browser tab strip.

browserResidency.policy: true LRU with the active page protected; evicted pages retain bounded resume metadata and remount on user or agent activation

architecture.manualProcessObservation: A packaged two-cycle churn run created and closed 30 disposable browser peers. Metadata reached the hard cap of 30, a 31st creation was rejected, and both peaks retained exactly six guest renderers. Both cleanups returned to the four-renderer baseline; final browser-core RSS was 0.9% above baseline, no disposable tab restored after restart, and no helper survived quit.
